text: Bitcoin is holding near $80.5k with modest losses while Ethereum underperformed with a steeper 1.8% drop, suggesting some rotation away from altcoins despite elevated greed conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and rising indicates strong confidence, yet Bitcoin's dominance climbing to 59% reveals investors are consolidating into the largest asset rather than chasing smaller-cap gains. Volume of $80B remains healthy, pointing to conviction behind the current levels rather than thin-market moves.
